item.title: OpenClaw Docker Setup (2026): Run the Gateway in a Container
item.description:
How do you run OpenClaw in Docker?

Run ./scripts/docker/setup.sh from the root of the OpenClaw repository. The script builds the Gateway image as openclaw:local, asks for your model provider API keys, writes a Gateway token to .env, and starts the Gateway with Docker Compose. Then open http://127.0.0.1:18789/ and paste the token into Settings. The steps come from the OpenClaw Docker docs, read 2026-11-21.

Docker is optional. The docs suggest it for a throwaway Gateway or a machine where you do not want local installs. If you develop on your own computer, the normal install is simpler.
